concept.concept: A hand-lettered mug reading 'Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself' with a small illustrated jar of bubbling sourdough.
concept.audience: Dedicated sourdough bakers who treat their starter as a pet
concept.rationale: This taps directly into a real, widely-shared joke within the sourdough community. Mugs are the #1 gifting item for this demographic. The concept requires zero explanation for the target audience and photographs well for social sharing.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a glass jar with a metal lid containing bubbling sourdough starter, positioned center-left. The jar shows active fermentation with 3-4 large white bubbles emerging from tan dough. Above and wrapping around the jar in a bold retro sans-serif typeface, the text 'Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself' arches gently. Solid color palette: cream (#F5E6D3), dark brown (#2C1810), white (#FFFFFF), and warm gray (#8B7355). Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition on a plain solid light gray background with generous margins. Design elements grouped tightly together, away from edges. Screen-print aesthetic with clean sharp edges and high contrast.
design.text_on_design: Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, arched above and around the jar illustration

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself' is a generic humorous expression referencing the common sourdough baking hobby and does not reference any known trademark, brand, celebrity, character, or protected slogan. The accompanying illustrated sourdough jar is a generic depiction with no brand-specific elements. This type of relatable baking humor is broadly considered common expression in the print-on-demand space and presents minimal IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: The text is garbled and incorrect. Instead of 'Fed My Starter Before I Fed Myself', the design reads 'FEBBED MY STARTER I YBSELF' with missing words, misspellings, and malformed lettering. The required text is incomplete and corrupted.
